author: Kushal
problem: Read N strings of length M (N up to 8). Print Yes if they can be reordered so that every adjacent pair differs in exactly one character, otherwise No.
bug_description: Uses break instead of exit() after printing Yes, so the final No is printed as well.

comments.accurate: Tries every ordering of the strings and prints Yes as soon as one has adjacent strings differing by one character
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries every ordering, prints Yes for the first one that works, then prints the closing No line
comments.wrong_location: Permutation loop exit verified; check diff when the strings have different lengths
